name: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd
title: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd - 500233 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume +11% and EBITDA margin 19.19% (vs 10.01%) as Morbi gas shutdown removes a key competitor's supply, but Morbi restart from 1 May and gas-price pass-through add uncertainty; no volume guidance given.

utilisation.quote: our production will be, as Rishi said just now, from 16th of April, all the plants are running at full capacity

triggers.label: Morbi plants shut in March; production -7%
triggers.quote: The production has fallen by 7% during the quarter due to shutdown of our Morbi plants in March

triggers.label: Price hike 12-13% North, 16-17% Morbi
triggers.quote: we have taken a price increase of roughly 12% to 13% in our North plants and Morbi has been slightly higher around 16% to 17%

triggers.label: Only 70-90 Morbi plants running
triggers.quote: as of today, there are only about 70, 80, 90 plants which are running

triggers.label: Working capital cycle 65 → 51 days
triggers.quote: the working capital cycle improved by 14 days to 51 days as compared to 65 days on 31st of December

triggers.label: Volume growth 11% in Q4
triggers.quote: this quarter we achieved a volume growth of 11%

guidance.quote: we should be maintaining between 18% to 19%
we have decided not to give any volume guidance

red_flags.label: Outsourcing supply uncertain; Morbi plants not at full run
red_flags.quote: Outsourcing is still a little problem because as we just said that at Morbi a lot of plants are still shut down

red_flags.label: Price cut risk: flexibility on discounts
red_flags.quote: We might be a little more flexible in terms of our pricing.

evasions.quote: we cannot break it down quarter-wise, but the good momentum has started now
we will not see over and above
we have yet to take a call
